# Hop To It Events

> Hop To It Events is a full-service event planning and production company that has been planning and producing events since 2010. It plans corporate events, brand activations, team building, festivals, fundraisers, food truck catering and private parties, and creates its own signature food and drink festivals in 30+ U.S. markets.

Hop To It Events plans and produces events for clients and also creates, markets, tickets and runs its own signature event brands, which is its main difference from other event planners. Contact: hello@hoptoit.events. Inquiries: https://hoptoit.events/plan-your-event/

## Key facts

- Type: full-service event planning and production company
- Experience: planning and executing events since 2010
- Reach: 100+ events produced in 30+ U.S. markets
- Signature event brands (15): Donut Fest, Chef Battle, Bartender Battle, Wine Bash, Wing Fest, Say Cheese Fest, Sweets + Snacks Fest, Cheers + Drink Fest, Donut & Dessert Fest, Treat Me Fest, Drink Local, After Work Social, Cocktail Shake Off, Pizza Party, Donut 5K
- Clients: corporate HR, marketing and event teams; brands and agencies; cities, chambers and tourism organizations; shopping centers and property managers; nonprofits
- Markets where events have been produced: Atlanta, Austin, Bakersfield, Bay Area, Birmingham, Boston, Cedar Rapids, Charleston, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, Des Moines, Detroit, Grand Rapids, Hawaii, Indianapolis, Kansas City, Las Vegas, Los Angeles, Madison, Minneapolis, Nashville, New Orleans, Orange County, Phoenix, Portland, Quad Cities, St. Louis, San Diego, Sioux Falls, Spokane, Washington, D.C.

## Services

- [Corporate Event Planning](https://hoptoit.events/corporate-event-planning/): Plan unforgettable corporate events with Hop To It Events. From employee celebrations to customer events, we handle planning, vendors, and production.
- [Food Truck Catering](https://hoptoit.events/food-truck-catering/): Book food trucks for corporate lunches, private parties, festivals, and community events. Hop To It coordinates food truck catering for your occasion.
- [Brand Activations](https://hoptoit.events/brand-activations/): Create memorable brand activations, product sampling events, experiential campaigns, and consumer experiences with Hop To It Events.
- [Corporate Team Building](https://hoptoit.events/corporate-team-building/): Bring your team together with interactive corporate team-building events, culinary competitions, and customized group experiences.
- [Festival & Community Events](https://hoptoit.events/festival-event-planning/): Full-service festival and community event planning, including food festivals, public celebrations, vendor coordination, and event production.
- [Employee Appreciation](https://hoptoit.events/employee-appreciation-events/): Celebrate your employees with food truck lunches, office festivals, team activities, and customized employee appreciation events.
- [Company Picnics](https://hoptoit.events/company-picnics/): Plan a company picnic with food trucks, games, entertainment, and full-service event coordination. Create a memorable celebration for your team.
- [Grand Openings & Launches](https://hoptoit.events/grand-openings-product-launches/): Create excitement for your next grand opening, business launch, or product debut with professional event planning, activations, and production.
- [Fundraisers & Nonprofits](https://hoptoit.events/fundraiser-event-planning/): Plan engaging nonprofit fundraisers, charity festivals, benefit events, and community celebrations with Hop To It Events.
- [Trade Show Activations](https://hoptoit.events/trade-show-activations/): Stand out at your next trade show with interactive brand activations, culinary demonstrations, hospitality events, and experiential marketing.
- [Event Entertainment](https://hoptoit.events/event-entertainment/): Add memorable entertainment to your next event with culinary competitions, interactive activities, live performers, and customized experiences.
- [Private Parties](https://hoptoit.events/private-party-planning/): Plan unforgettable birthday parties, graduation celebrations, private gatherings, and social events with food, entertainment, and event coordination.
- [Event Staffing & Management](https://hoptoit.events/event-staffing-management/): Get professional support for event staffing, vendor coordination, guest registration, and on-site event management.
- [Bar & Beverage Services](https://hoptoit.events/bar-beverage-services/): Plan memorable beverage experiences with mobile bar coordination, cocktail experiences, mocktail stations, and beverage event planning.
- [Event Rentals & Decor](https://hoptoit.events/event-rentals-decor/): Coordinate event rentals, furniture, tents, decor, staging, and event layouts with Hop To It Events' planning and production team.
